MultipleSystemsEstimation

Methods for multiple systems estimation using Poisson log-linear models, with particular attention to sparse capture data, model selection and its associated uncertainty, and Bayesian thresholding of interaction effects.

The package implements methodology from Silverman (2020), Chan, Silverman and Vincent (2021), and Silverman, Chan and Vincent (2024).

References

Silverman, B. W. (2020). Multiple-systems analysis for the quantification of modern slavery: classical and Bayesian approaches. Journal of the Royal Statistical Society: Series A, 183, 691–736.

Chan, L., Silverman, B. W. and Vincent, K. (2021). Multiple systems estimation for sparse capture data: inferential challenges when there are nonoverlapping lists. Journal of the American Statistical Association, 116, 129–143.

Silverman, B. W., Chan, L. and Vincent, K. (2024). Multiple systems estimation with model selection and uncertainty. Statistics and Computing.
